en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a riverside scene with a metal bridge over water, stone embankments, trees on the left and large classical multi‑storey buildings on the right. The bridge has railings and gas-style street lamps. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the place as Göteborg and gives the viewpoint as Stora Nygatan från Slussen. Small printed numbering appears at the lower left.
